subject: Dont lick the Uru
body:
Hang onto that Uru, you'll want five of them for the Gauntlet later along with a Bedrock Dust Block. Thor's hammer got forged in the heart of a dying star and yours came out of a factory appliance.

P.S. dont lick it. I licked it. My face already looks like an avocado had relations with an older, more disgusting avocado so whats the worst that could happen.
